state_of_play.narrative: Risk stays bid worldwide as the AI-capex complex broadens, but the tape is now capex-discriminated: reward the recipients of AI capex (memory, optics, power) and fade the payers (capex-heavy builders, pre-payback neoclouds). US indices sit at Friday's record closes into a stacked catalyst week — RKLB tonight, CoreWeave Tue, and a twin midweek gate Wed 12 Aug where July CPI lands on the same session as the US–China tariff-truce deadline. Gold holds ~$4,329 just off its record, the dollar firmed to ~99.8, and a still-low VIX (~15) signals calm rather than conviction. The crack worth watching is the US labour turn — July payrolls fell 23k with 103k of downward revisions.

A labour market shedding jobs is a slow-burn recession signal.
signals.assessment: First real crack in the labour data; nudges the book toward duration/quality defensives.

signals.headline: Lumentum reports Thu — first optics-demand read of the confirm week
summary: A strong 800G/1.6T order print corroborates the demand leg.
AI-cluster optics +60% to ~$26bn in 2026 (LightCounting).
Caveat: rich valuations (COHR/LITE >127x trailing), whippy tape.
signals.assessment: Strongest recent theme; a clean print extends the demand + reshoring case.

signals.headline: Iran–Oman reports to manage the Strait of Hormuz ease oil premium
summary: Reports of a deal to manage Hormuz softened the energy-supply premium.
Oil the swing factor; Brent eased into the weekend.
Fragile, not resolved — carried as WATCH.
signals.assessment: Geopolitics de-escalating but fragile; a truce breakdown Wed would collide with CPI.

signals.headline: BTC ~$64.9k, +3% on the week off the 1 Aug capitulation low
summary: Range-bound ~$65k; Clarity Act (market-structure rails) the driver over price.
MSTR tracks it in a ~$92–102 band (exit id 1 leaning wrong).
+3% on the week off the ~$62.2k low.
signals.assessment: Flat-to-strengthening; legislation over price is the theme.

signals.headline: European and Japanese equities extend on the ex-US rotation
summary: STOXX 600 +1.7% and Nikkei +1.9% on the week.
A softer dollar path and cheap valuations pulling in flows.
China +0.3% Mon on US–China truce-extension hopes.
signals.assessment: Ex-US rotation strengthening; supports the international driver.

signals.headline: Cerebras -35% post-debut — the crowding/valuation tell
summary: Newest AI cohort punished on crowding/valuation vs memory holding its re-rating.
A corroborating positioning tell for the capex-intensity factor.
Recipients firm, payers/newest-cohort soft.
signals.assessment: Confirms the recipient-vs-payer split within the AI trade.

signals.headline: UK primes fire (BAE £84bn backlog) while RHM lags
summary: BAE record £84bn backlog; RR raised targets.
RHM.DE -40% YTD — the EU laggard.
RKLB defense mission (Neutron) cross-links here.
signals.assessment: UK-prime restage-up firing; EU weak — selective on valuation.

signals.headline: 10Y ~4.6% after the jobs shock; Sept-HIKE odds ~42%
summary: Dovish tilt held; but the regime is a hike risk, not a cut.
Chair Warsh has signalled he would still hike on a hot CPI.
July CPI Wed the macro gate (cons +0.2% m/m, 3.4% headline, 2.5% core).
signals.assessment: Easing bias supports gold/crypto/duration; CPI the next timing test.

signals.headline: SMR offtake momentum: Hermes 2 follows Oklo–Meta Ohio
summary: Datacentre operators contracting nuclear baseload batteries can't cover.
First SMR units are 2030+; licensing progress the confirm.
Uranium term firmness the tell; break <$80 the kill.
signals.assessment: Datacentre-nuclear link strengthening; early-stage but increasingly real.

signals.headline: China tightens rare-earth and magnet export controls
summary: New licences required for several rare-earth magnet exports.
Western miners and processors rallied on supply-security demand.
Governments accelerated offtake and stockpiling plans.
signals.assessment: Structural tailwind for ex-China rare-earth supply; volatile but strategic.
